accent_roles.#E7F1FA: pale blue main page background — most frequent background color

gradient_pill.use: ONLY on the 03-section 3-strategy pill cards AND 10-closing right-side mini pill strip. Each card is a single solid color, NOT a within-card gradient. The three cards together form a left→right blue→violet progression.

ai_box_gradient.use: ONLY on the 04-key-message left 'AI' square box
ai_box_gradient.note: slight cyan tint (#4F99F1, #5398FF) allowed at low opacity in this single decorative element — NEVER used as primary tone elsewhere

cover_sphere_glow.note: decorative translucent spheres, NOT primary palette

color.shadow: none (exception: 09-narrative central hub allows 0-2px very subtle shadow; pale glow opacity ~20% behind radial diagram only)

type.fallback_kr: Noto Sans KR, Apple SD Gothic Neo, Malgun Gothic, sans-serif

body_main_title.korean_dot_usage: frequent middle-dot (·) between paired words: 과학기술·AI, 바이오·양자, 4대 지역 AX, 민·관

section_indicator.format: 'NN ─ 섹션명' (em-dash). Examples: '01 ─ AI 3강 도약 본격화 및 국민체감 성과창출', '02 ─ 과학기술 기반 혁신성장 추진', '03 ─ 새로운 거버넌스로 대한민국 혁신역량 극대화', '맺음말 ─ 2026 상반기 추진 로드맵'

chip_header.use: section chip headers like '국민 모두가 함께 누리는 K-AI', '국가 AI 대전환', 'AI·디지털 안심국가', '글로벌 AI 기본사회 실현'

card_header.on_band: rendered on #1A4BC6 top band (02-agenda style) OR #0F41BD row header chip (08-comparison style)

card_body_keyword.use: bold keyword leading a body line, followed by lighter description

checklist_text.mark: ✓ in #002060, 9pt, with 4pt right margin before text

pill_card_number.use: ONLY on 03-section 3-strategy pill cards. NOT a giant display number.

pill_card_caption.use: small label above the big number on 03-section cards

mini_pill_strip_label.use: 10-closing right-side mini pill strip ('01 AI 3강', '02 혁신성장', '03 새 거버넌스'). 1 line, ~1/3 size of 03-section pills.

ribbon_label.use: left side of bottom navy ribbon

ribbon_keywords.use: right of '상반기 핵심과제' label, on bottom navy ribbon. 3-4 keywords

chart_value_label.use: value above each bar on the 08-comparison '자력 R&D' card mini bar chart
chart_value_label.note: NOT a giant display KPI. Modest label above the bar.

node_label_radial.use: satellite node label on 09-narrative radial governance diagram

central_node_label.use: central hub label '과학기술정보통신부' on 09-narrative — slightly larger than satellites

radial_supporting_box_label.use: 09-narrative supporting boxes — '부처 AX·혁신 지원' (above hub) and 'R&D 예산 전략적 배분·조정' (below hub)

timeline_quarter_label.use: 10-closing quarter labels '1Q' / '2Q' / '3Q' / '4Q' above each timeline node

timeline_keyword.use: 10-closing 2-line keyword text below each timeline node

shape.pill_card_shape: fully rounded horizontal pill (height ~2.2in, width ~3.4in), single solid fill per card
shape.row_header_chip_shape: fully rounded vertical pill (~2.2in wide), royal-blue #0F41BD bg
shape.card_border: 0.5pt solid #D3DAE6 OR borderless when card has filled background
shape.icon_style: flat, monochrome blue (#0F41BD or #2277F2), 24-36px small icons in card headers OR 60-80px round-bg icons centered in 2x2 icon cards. Ministry-style placeholder mini logos on 09-narrative satellites (~24px round).
illustration_pieces_allowed: 01-cover right half: pale-blue translucent sphere/glow cluster (decorative, opacity ~40%, with weak cyan tints #4F99F1/#5398FF allowed)
04-key-message left: 1.4in 'AI' square with blue gradient fill #2366D9~#5398FF
07-cards right column tail: realistic Nuriho rocket illustration (vertical, with flame + launch pad)
09-narrative center: generic circular emblem placeholder (do NOT use actual ministry logo)
09-narrative satellites: small ministry-style circular logo placeholders

chart.use: single simple bar chart, ONLY on the 08-comparison '자력 R&D' card embed. NO other chart types in this pack.
chart.bar_color: #002060 OR #2277F2 (single solid color; allowed: one paler tone + one darker tone)
chart.axis: NONE — no x-axis line, no y-axis line, no tick marks
chart.value_label: above each bar, 22pt Pretendard Bold #FFFFFF (when on dark card) or #002060 (when on light card)
chart.trend_arrow: thin navy curve or straight arrow from low bar to tall bar, indicating increase; also '2026 → 2030' simple text allowed
chart.forbidden_charts: line chart, pie chart, donut, 3D bar, stacked bar, scatter, area, polar — NONE of these exist in the source
chart.note: The actual source deck has exactly ONE chart (p-8). Do not invent additional charts. Most data points (GPU 26만장, 5.9조 등) appear as text labels inside cards, not as charts.

diagram_kit.language: Light theme government infographic. All diagrams sit on pale blue #E7F1FA / #E0EEF9 backgrounds. Borders are 0.5pt #D3DAE6 hairlines or absent. NO shadows, NO 3D, NO glow. Colors restricted to navy #002060, royal blue #0F41BD, card-header blue #1A4BC6, highlight #2277F2, connector grey-blue #C5D3E2 — strictly no cyan/turquoise as primary tone.

checklist_3_column.structure: Top capsule '국가 최대 위기를 극복' (#E0EEF9 pill, 13pt #002060). Then 3 equal-width columns, each ~3.8in wide × 4.5in tall, gutter 0.15in.
checklist_3_column.card_top_band: #1A4BC6 fill, ~0.45in tall, white 15pt Bold header text centered. Headers: '훼손된 연구생태계 복원·강화' / "'AI 3대 강국 도약' 기반 마련" / '과학기술 중심 거버넌스 구축'
checklist_3_column.checklist_row: ✓ mark (9pt navy) + bold keyword (13pt #1C2848) + description (11pt #1C2848), row gap 0.08in
checklist_3_column.footer_strip: below the 3 columns, a thin pale-blue band with single italic summary line in #3C4860 ('성장 기반을 토대로 2026년부터는 가시적 성과창출에 박차'), NOT the navy ribbon

strategy_pill_cards.structure: 3 horizontal fully-rounded pill cards, ~3.4in wide × 2.2in tall each, gutter 0.25in, center-aligned
strategy_pill_cards.card_contents: small caption 13pt white top + large '01' / '02' / '03' (28pt white Bold) + 2-line description (14pt white SemiBold)
strategy_pill_cards.card_01_text: AI 3강 도약 본격화 및 / 국민체감 성과창출
strategy_pill_cards.background_decor: pale-blue circular glow at top-left and bottom-right corners (subtle, opacity ~30%)
strategy_pill_cards.important: These are PARALLEL strategies, not a ranking. Do NOT add crowns, gold markers, or rank-1/2/3 hierarchy. All three cards have equal visual weight.

asymmetric_top2_bottom_box3col.structure: Body splits into upper-zone (~45%) and lower-zone (~50%). Upper-zone = 2-split chip (left small + right wide). Lower-zone = single full-width card titled '세계 최고 수준의 AI 혁신생태계' containing 3 sub-columns ('차세대 AI칩', 'AI 인재·스타트업', 'AI 고속도로')
asymmetric_top2_bottom_box3col.upper_left_chip: royal-blue #0F41BD chip header text + 1.4in 'AI' square (blue→violet gradient fill #2366D9~#5398FF, white 'AI' 32pt) + right-side caption '세계 Top 10 "독자 AI 모델" 확보, 오픈소스 제공'
asymmetric_top2_bottom_box3col.upper_right_chip: chip header '다양한 분야의 특화 AI 서비스 개발·확산' + 3-card stack (특화 AI 서비스 / AI 만명 10대 프로젝트 / 전국민 AI 경진대회). v3 CORRECTION: this is CARD STACK, not arrow flow.
asymmetric_top2_bottom_box3col.forbidden: Do NOT make this a symmetric 6-cell grid. Do NOT make upper-right a 3-node arrow flow (v2 mistake). Asymmetry is the signature.

four_plus_four_stack_with_right_aux.use: AI transformation slide (05-chart slot, but actually card stack — chart is on 08-comparison)
four_plus_four_stack_with_right_aux.structure: Left wide column ~65% contains TWO stacked 4-card grids (4 cards horizontal each, 2 rows of 4 = 8 cards total). Right narrow column ~35% contains 2 vertical cards.
four_plus_four_stack_with_right_aux.card: pale-blue #E0EEF9 fill, ~1.7in wide × ~1.2in tall, white inner area, small icon top-left, 13pt #1C2848 title + 10pt body
four_plus_four_stack_with_right_aux.section_chip_above_each_grid: left edge royal-blue #0F41BD bold label ('국가 AI 대전환' / 'AI·디지털 안심국가')
four_plus_four_stack_with_right_aux.right_column: chip header '글로벌 AI 기본사회 실현' + 2 vertical cards (UAE 등 K-AI 확산 with globe icon / 아태 AI 허브 조성 with hub icon)
four_plus_four_stack_with_right_aux.left_to_right_arrow: v3 NEW — large solid arrow (1.5-2pt #002060, straight line + triangular arrowhead) flowing from left wide column toward right narrow column, placed between them

two_by_two_icon_cards_plus_three_col_plu.structure: Left ~50%: 2×2 icon cards. Right ~50%: 3 vertical columns with round icons. Bottom row (y 70-85%): 2 horizontal cards under '출연연 국가 임무중심 연구소 개편' chip.
two_by_two_icon_cards_plus_three_col_plu.left_2x2_cards: white #FFFFFF fill, 0.5pt #D3DAE6 hairline, 6px radius, top ~36px round icon (humanoid/semiconductor/molecule/sun-wind), 13pt Bold title + 10pt body. Titles: 휴머노이드 / 차세대 반도체 / 희토류 대체·저감 / 청정에너지
two_by_two_icon_cards_plus_three_col_plu.right_3_columns: each column topped by ~50px round pale-blue circle containing white flat icon, then 14pt Bold #002060 column title and 11pt body. Columns: 바이오 / 양자 / 핵융합
two_by_two_icon_cards_plus_three_col_plu.bottom_2_cards: 전략기술 분야 산학연 결성 추진 / 성과중심 인센티브 신설, 가능·출연연 운영 합리화

two_by_two_icon_cards_plus_two_card_plus.structure: Left wide ~65%: chip header '우리 위성은 우리 발사체로 발사' + 2×2 cards. Right narrow ~35%: chip header '누리호 2029년 달 통신 궤도선 발사 도전' + 2 vertical cards + far-right rocket illustration.
two_by_two_icon_cards_plus_two_card_plus.left_2x2_cards: 누리호 반복발사 / 재사용 발사체 개발 / 우주개척 신기능 발굴, 민간발사 지원 / 공공·우주산업 확대, 국제협력
two_by_two_icon_cards_plus_two_card_plus.right_2_cards: 달 통신 궤도선·누리호 '29 (시스템 기본설계, 일부 탑재체 개발 착수) / 달 착륙선·차세대 발사체 '32
two_by_two_icon_cards_plus_two_card_plus.rocket_illustration: realistic vertical rocket with flame + launch pad, placed at far right of right narrow column

two_by_three_matrix_with_row_header_and_.structure: 2 rows. Each row = left vertical pill row-header chip (~2.2in wide) + 3 cards (each ~2.7in × 1.7in)
two_by_three_matrix_with_row_header_and_.row_header_chip: royal-blue #0F41BD background, white 14pt Bold text wrapping 2 lines, fully-rounded vertical pill
two_by_three_matrix_with_row_header_and_.row_2_header: 자율·창의를 토대로 실패해도 다시 도전하는 R&D 생태계 구축
two_by_three_matrix_with_row_header_and_.row_2_cards: 기초연구(Bb-Q) / 자력 R&D / 셀러형 R&D 사고
two_by_three_matrix_with_row_header_and_.embedded_chart: ONE of the 6 cards (the '자력 R&D' card, row 2 middle) contains the simple 2-bar mini chart described in slide.chart

radial_hub_spoke_signature.use: governance slide (09-narrative) — SIGNATURE diagram and visual climax of the deck
radial_hub_spoke_signature.structure: Central hub: 0.9in diameter circular white card + generic circular emblem placeholder + 15pt Bold #002060 label '과학기술정보통신부'. Satellites: 8-12 small rounded rectangular cards (~1.2in × 0.7in) arranged in a radial ring around the hub at varying distances (asymmetric). Each satellite has a tiny ministry-style placeholder icon + 13pt Bold #002060 label.

radial_hub_spoke_signature.supporting_box_above_hub: pale-blue rounded pill chip '부처 AX·혁신 지원' (12pt #002060)
radial_hub_spoke_signature.supporting_box_below_hub: pale-blue rounded pill chip 'R&D 예산 전략적 배분·조정' (12pt #002060)
radial_hub_spoke_signature.background: very subtle pale-blue glow circle behind the entire radial layout, opacity 20%
radial_hub_spoke_signature.central_hub_shadow: 0-2px very subtle shadow allowed (only diagram element permitted shadow)
radial_hub_spoke_signature.important: This diagram is the visual climax of the deck. Do NOT replace with a 2×2 matrix or pyramid. The radial hub-and-spoke is the signature. Connector color is the v3 NEW #C5D3E2 — not pure grey.

horizontal_quarter_timeline.node_4q_keywords: 부처 AX 1차 성과 보고 / 차세대 발사체 개발 진척

mini_pill_summary_strip.structure: 3 vertical (or horizontal) mini pills, ~1/3 size of 03-section pills
mini_pill_summary_strip.card_text: single line, 11pt 700 white. '01 AI 3강' / '02 혁신성장' / '03 새 거버넌스'

diagram_kit.render: SVG precise. NO div-block bars. NO emoji icons. NO clipart.

slide.transition: cut OR fade 0.2s. NO count-up, NO swoop, NO 3D rotation.

pill_cards_blue_purple_gradient (그라디언트 블루→퍼플 알약 카드 — 3대 전략 병렬 번호) — 03, 10 우측 미니

prohibitions: 사이언/청록 톤 메인 사용 금지 — 그라디언트는 블루→퍼플 한정 (03/10 우측 미니), 표지/AI박스 예외
카드 내부 그라디언트 금지 — 표면 단색
'부총리·17년·부활' 라벨 사용 금지 — 원본 9p 어디에도 없음
거대 수치 디스플레이(80pt+) 금지 — 본문 최대 약 30pt
다크 프리미엄 테마 금지 — 라이트 정통 정부 톤 유지

pages.label: 표지 — 옅은 블루 그라디언트 + 인디고 타이틀 + 우측 구체 글로우

3대 전략 알약 카드 — 블루→퍼플 병렬 3장 (순위 아님)

결의 슬로건 + 1Q→4Q 가로 타임라인 + 우 미니 3 알약 strip (v3 확장)
